title: Adaptive Thrift Tracks: Initiative Ledger for Request-level Cost Experiments
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: This initiative creates a single cross-cycle ledger for running and tracking request-level cost experiments ("Adaptive Thrift Tracks"). The ledger harmonizes hypotheses, experiment artifacts, acceptance gates, and rollout policies for batching, KV-prefetch/caching, and quantization profiles. Goal: achieve measurable per-request cost reductions for 3 top traffic cohorts while maintaining quality SLOs. Scope: experiment design templates, a canonical field-lab runbook, dataset/prompt sets, evaluation thresholds, dashboard tiles, rollout automation hooks, and post-rollout regressions playbook.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Ledger contains canonical template for hypothesis + metric mapping for batching, caching, and quantization. 2) Field lab completes at least three cohort experiments with results logged and tagged. 3) Console dashboard shows per-cohort cost delta, p95 latency, and quality/regression signals. 4) Autoscaler/rollout automation is wired to the experiment tag and canary rules. 5) One production backlog PR (with rollout plan) approved for runtime-1.20 release.
tasks: Define hypothesis template and metric mapping (tokens/request, p95 latency, perf/cost ratio)
Assemble evaluation prompt sets and golden responses for three customer cohorts
Implement experiment tagging in request router and telemetry (ENG-43210)
Build dashboard tiles in Console for per-request economics and quality drift
Prototype thrift-v1 quant profile and validate output quality on held prompts
Run field-lab: run batching + KV-prefetch variant against baseline for 72-hour window
Analyze field-lab results and generate playbook entry with rollback thresholds
Draft rollout automation rules and a canary schedule for Dedicated customers
